narrative:
COGS planning models USD 11.5B of cost of goods. Budget gross margin is 81.9%.

API & Raw Materials is the largest cost line at 30% of COGS, driven by batch volume × api cost per kg (oral solid dose) / media & resin (biologics). Cost drivers are linked to the volume forecast so they flex with the revenue plan.

signals.title: RSG programme: up to USD 2.0B of restructuring to tag once and track to Core through 2029
signals.source: AstraZeneca 9M & Q3 2026 results (30 Oct 2026) — Reshaping for Sustainable Growth
signals.excerpt: Reshaping for Sustainable Growth is expected to cost up to USD 2.0B in one-time restructuring and to deliver USD 1.5B of annualised pre-tax run-rate benefits, essentially complete by the end of 2029. Each charge needs one tag that flows into provisions, the Reported-to-Core bridge and the controls evidence, instead of being rebuilt in each entity workbook.

signals.title: USD 118M of Q3 clinical trial accruals were still estimate-only at WD+2
signals.source: SDP Close Control — CRO and investigator-site accruals
signals.excerpt: Clinical trial accruals of USD 1.6B for Q3 were 92.6% confirmed by CRO and site data at WD+2. The remaining USD 118M is concentrated in three late-stage oncology programmes with new CRO partners. The accrual agent matches patient-visit data to contract milestones and proposes the true-up for controller approval.
